# Corelume Tech

> Corelume Tech builds high-performance, ad-light HTML5 browser games, productivity apps (FocusFlow), and fast digital utilities. Zero mandatory downloads, accessible on any modern web browser.

## Free Browser Games
- [War Tanks](https://www.corelumetech.in/play-war-tanks.html): Fast-paced 2-player split-keyboard artillery tank game with destructible 2D terrain.
- [Hex Blast](https://www.corelumetech.in/play-hex-blast.html): Hexagonal tile puzzle and chain reaction game.
- [Sky Dodge](https://www.corelumetech.in/play-sky-dodge.html): High-speed aerial dodging reflex trainer.
- [Orb Clash](https://www.corelumetech.in/play-orb-clash.html): Arena physics brawler for local 2-player battles.
- [Game Hub](https://www.corelumetech.in/game-hub.html): Complete catalog of free browser games with instant web launch.

## Mobile Apps & Utilities
- [FocusFlow (Google Play)](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.focusflow.corelumetech): ADHD-friendly Pomodoro timer with 3D botanical gardens, ambient soundscapes, and streak heatmaps.
- [GetClipFast](https://getclicpfast.com): Free online video downloader and audio converter.
- [ClickSpeedLab](https://clickspeedlab.com): Browser-based CPS reflex trainer and click speed benchmarking tool.
- [Crypto DCA Calculator](https://www.corelumetech.in/crypto-dca-calculator.html): Interactive dollar-cost averaging backtest calculator.

- [War Tanks Strategy Guide](https://www.corelumetech.in/war-tanks-guide.html): Tactical trajectories and weapon loadouts guide.
